json.reason: Project-specific contract violation: domain events published directly on the in-memory bus (bus.emit) are lost if the process crashes before the state change is persisted; they must go through the transactional outbox. Every bus.emit call site is syntactically detectable.
json.title: Domain event emitted on the in-memory bus instead of the outbox
json.message: bus.emit() delivers this event in-process before the change is persisted, so it is lost on a crash; use outbox.enqueue() instead
json.note: bus.emit fires immediately and is not stored with the state change, so a crash between the mutation and delivery drops the event. Enqueue it on the transactional outbox (outbox.enqueue(name, payload)) so the event is persisted alongside the change and delivered at least once.
